verdict.rationale: A CDP like mParticle could plausibly offer a separate sandbox or development environment, so this axis applies. However, no item in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, a development environment, or test data isolated from production. The cited docs cover event ingestion, IDSync, audiences, privacy controls and Warehouse Sync, none of which address test isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
